title: Rankin bound for pairwise obtuse unit vectors
statement: Let $S$ be a finite set of vectors in the Euclidean space $\bbr^n$, each of norm $1$, such that any two distinct vectors $u, v \in S$ satisfy $\langle u, v\rangle \le 0$. Then $\abs{S} \le 2n$.
hypotheses_covered: S is a finite set of vectors in R^n
each vector in S is a unit vector
distinct vectors have non-positive inner product
replaced:
A finite set $S$ of unit vectors in $\mathbb{R}^n$ with pairwise non-positive inner
products satisfies $\abs{S} \le 2n$.
